prompt: Using the attached images ONLY as a style reference (rendering, materials, lighting, palette, composition, background treatment) — do not copy their objects — create a new card illustration of a tall crooked stone wizard tower with a purple cone roof and round windows in its real environment: enchanted forest clearing with giant trees and a blue sky; the object is the clear central hero and fills about 70-80% of the frame, tall or wide objects may be cropped by the frame edge, the environment is recognizable but simplified: a few large shapes of the landscape and sky with fluffy clouds, only a little secondary detail, softly blurred, bright daylight, no characters. Style: stylized 3D casual mobile game collectible card art, warm animated-movie look, soft rounded chunky shapes, slightly exaggerated proportions, no outlines, every object keeps its real material (painted wood, brass, iron, leather, fabric, ceramic, glass, baked food) with soft hand-painted texture and medium detail, matte or satin surfaces, warm soft diffuse lighting like a sunny afternoon, gentle soft highlights, soft contact shadow, the object is the most saturated element, background slightly softer, single object centered, fills about 75% of the width, top 12% of the frame kept clear, simplified forms, thick chunky parts instead of thin lattices or wires, no fine fibers or strands, no small scattered details. No text, letters, numbers, logos, frames, borders, rounded corners, card UI, stars, outlines, photorealism, dark gloomy tones, clutter, people, glossy plastic toy look, wet shine, chrome or mirror reflections, neon glow. candidates.comment: Clear wizard tower and good hero framing, but a bit too smooth/toy-like and the roof reaches into the top safe area.
Best silhouette and category fit; reads instantly as a crooked wizard tower, but still slightly plastic/AI-smooth and too close to the top edge.
Readable and bright, but the star badge adds visual clutter and the rendering feels a little too glossy/toy-like; top safe area is not clear.

defects: Purple hat roof and stone tower are fused together with no clear structural joint under the brim.
Upper ring has uneven tooth-like stone blocks/brackets; several are different sizes and angles and appear melted into the wall or underside of the roof.
Small left-side round window is cut into the tower edge and appears partially flattened/embedded rather than fully circular.
Stone block courses are warped and inconsistent around the curved tower, especially near the upper taper.

judge.fix: Make the tower more like softly rendered real stone and fabric/wood, less glossy toy-like, and leave clear empty sky in the top 12%.
